hypothesis: Frozen features may limit head-only gains; low-rank updates to the final QKV weights may adapt spatial evidence with fewer trainable parameters than full block tuning.
controls: Same image pipeline, head learning rate 1e-4, weight decay .01, batch4 accumulation4, six epochs, patience3 and epoch zero eligible for every arm; no image augmentation.
selection: Three seeds for all four configurations. If an adapter ensemble improves both its live-image initialization and frozen validation reference, run three outer patient folds for the strongest qualifying adapter and matched head-only control; otherwise no external evaluation.
cv_source_policy: Each fold starts from its own pre-existing inner-fit MLP and statistics, never the full-development head; all source feature statistics and patient groups audited.
initialization_policy: Seed 20261124+seed before model construction and reset again afterward. All initial low-rank parameters saved and hashed; independent of arm order and resume position.
external_test_policy: No external images or outcomes used for optimization or selection.
